note: Fixed menu approved by a human. New items need a human's approval. Each feature lives in app/lab/<slug>/index.tsx and renders a <section data-lab="<slug>">.

features.name: Dark mode toggle
accept: A button switches the page theme (dark Forest / light Mist) and reports aria-pressed
Text contrast meets WCAG AA in both themes
The choice survives a reload (localStorage ab-theme)

features.name: FAQ accordion
accept: 4 questions
Only one answer open at a time
Works with the keyboard (Enter/Space)
aria-expanded is correct on every question

features.name: Pricing table
accept: Header illustration by Naomi Sato from public/lab/pricing-table/header.svg (fallback: soft gradient)
3 tiers with the middle one highlighted
Tiers stack on mobile
No sideways scroll at 390px

features.name: Animated counter
accept: 3 stats count up when scrolled into view
They stop at the exact values
Reduced motion shows the final values with no animation

features.name: Tabs
accept: 3 tabs
Arrow keys (and Home/End) move between tabs
Correct tablist/tab/tabpanel roles, aria-selected and aria-controls

features.name: Quote card
accept: A quote, a name and a role
3 example quotes rotate every 3s
Dots are buttons that jump to a quote
Avatar artwork by Naomi Sato from public/lab/testimonial-card/ (fallback: initials)
Rotation pauses while the mouse is over the card

features.name: Feature grid
accept: 6 cards with illustrated icons by Naomi Sato from public/lab/feature-grid/ (fallback: inline SVG)
3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile

features.name: Spanish translation
accept: An English/Español toggle switches the page's own visible text (H1, nav, footer, feature text) to Spanish
Toggling back restores the exact English text
html lang and aria-pressed follow the language
